entries.text: According to the first paragraph, the process of discovery is characterized by its ___. [A] uncertainty and complexity. [B] misconception and deceptiveness. 误解与欺骗性。 [C] logicality and objectivity. 逻辑性与客观性。 [D] systematicness and regularity. 系统性与规范性。 答案 A According to the first paragraph, the process of discovery is characterized by its ___.根据第一段，发现过程的特征在于其___。 [A] uncertainty and complexity. [B] misconception and deceptiveness.误解与欺骗性。 [C] logicality and objectivity.逻辑性与客观性。 [D] systematicness and regularity.系统性与规范性。 💡 考场思路首段：discovery frequently follows an ambiguous and complicated route——发现之路模糊而复杂。ambiguous = uncertainty，complicated = complexity。

entries.title: It can be inferred from Paragraph 2 that the credibility process requires ___.
entries.text: It can be inferred from Paragraph 2 that the credibility process requires ___. [A] strict inspection. 严格检查。 [B] shared efforts. [C] individual wisdom. 个人智慧。 [D] persistent innovation. 持续创新。 答案 B It can be inferred from Paragraph 2 that the credibility process requires ___.从第2款可以推断，可信度流程需要___。 [A] strict inspection.严格检查。 [B] shared efforts. [C] individual wisdom.个人智慧。 [D] persistent innovation.持续创新。 💡 考场思路第二段：it takes collective scrutiny and acceptance to transform a discovery claim——需要集体审视和接受。collective = shared。

entries.title: Paragraph 3 shows that a discovery claim becomes credible after it ___.
entries.text: Paragraph 3 shows that a discovery claim becomes credible after it ___. [A] has attracted the attention of the general public. 已引起公众的注意。 [B] has been examined by the scientific community. [C] has received recognition from editors and reviewers. 已获得编辑与审稿人的认可。 [D] has been frequently quoted by peer scientists. 常被同行科学家引用。 答案 B Paragraph 3 shows that a discovery claim becomes credible after it ___.第3款表明，发现声明在___之后变得可信。 [A] has attracted the attention of the general public.已引起公众的注意。 [B] has been examined by the scientific community. [C] has received recognition from editors and reviewers.已获得编辑与审稿人的认可。 [D] has been frequently quoted by peer scientists.常被同行科学家引用。 💡 考场思路第三段末：the interaction and confrontation... transforms an individual's discovery claim into the community's credible discovery——经过学界互动对抗后才成为可信发现。

entries.title: Albert Szent-Györgyi would most likely agree that ___.
entries.text: Albert Szent-Györgyi would most likely agree that ___. [A] scientific claims will survive challenges. 科学论断将经得起挑战。 [B] discoveries today inspire future research. 今天的发现激励未来的研究。 [C] efforts to make discoveries are justified. 探索发现的努力是合理的。 [D] scientific work calls for a critical mind. 答案 D Albert Szent-Györgyi would most likely agree that ___.Albert Szent-Györgyi很可能会同意___。 [A] scientific claims will survive challenges.科学论断将经得起挑战。 [B] discoveries today inspire future research.今天的发现激励未来的研究。 [C] efforts to make discoveries are justified.探索发现的努力是合理的。 [D] scientific work calls for a critical mind. 💡 考场思路森特-哲尔吉："看到每个人都看到的，想到没人想到的"——即科学工作需要批判性思维，不盲从。

entries.title: Which of the following would be the best title of the text?
entries.text: Which of the following would be the best title of the text? [A] Novelty as an Engine of Scientific Development. 新奇作为科学发展的引擎。 [B] Collective Scrutiny in Scientific Discovery. 科学发现中的集体审查。 [C] Evolution of Credibility in Doing Science. [D] Challenge to Credibility at the Gate to Science. 科学之门处可信度面临的挑战。 答案 C Which of the following would be the best title of the text?以下哪项是文字的最佳标题？ [A] Novelty as an Engine of Scientific Development.新奇作为科学发展的引擎。 [B] Collective Scrutiny in Scientific Discovery.科学发现中的集体审查。 [C] Evolution of Credibility in Doing Science. [D] Challenge to Credibility at the Gate to Science.科学之门处可信度面临的挑战。 💡 考场思路全文核心：发现声明如何经过可信性过程演变为可信发现，即科学中可信性的发展演变。C既点出 credibility 又点出过程性。 核心词汇 ambiguous adj. 模糊的 proto-science n. 原科学 scrutiny n. 审视 credibility n. 可信性 paradox n. 悖论 refutation n. 反驳 prevailing adj. 盛行的 novelty n. 新奇

entries.title: It can be learned from the first paragraph that ___.
entries.text: It can be learned from the first paragraph that ___. [A] Teamsters still have a large body of members. 卡车司机工会仍拥有庞大的成员群体。 [B] Jimmy Hoffa used to work as a civil servant. Jimmy Hoffa曾是一名公务员。 [C] unions have enlarged their public-sector membership. [D] the government has improved its relationship with unionists. 政府已改善与工会人士的关系。 答案 C It can be learned from the first paragraph that ___.从第一段可以看出， ___。 [A] Teamsters still have a large body of members.卡车司机工会仍拥有庞大的成员群体。 [B] Jimmy Hoffa used to work as a civil servant.Jimmy Hoffa曾是一名公务员。 [C] unions have enlarged their public-sector membership. [D] the government has improved its relationship with unionists.政府已改善与工会人士的关系。 💡 考场思路首段：政府工作人员工会比例从1960年的1/10升至现在的36%，2009年公共部门工会人数超过私营部门——工会在公共部门的会员扩大了。

entries.title: Which of the following is true of Paragraph 2?
entries.text: Which of the following is true of Paragraph 2? [A] Public-sector unions are prudent in taking actions. 公共部门工会在行动上审慎。 [B] Education is required for public-sector union membership. 加入公共部门工会需要受教育。 [C] Labor Party has long been fighting against public-sector unions. 工党长期与公共部门工会对立。 [D] Public-sector unions seldom get in trouble for their actions. 答案 D Which of the following is true of Paragraph 2?对于第2款，以下哪项是正确的？ [A] Public-sector unions are prudent in taking actions.公共部门工会在行动上审慎。 [B] Education is required for public-sector union membership.加入公共部门工会需要受教育。 [C] Labor Party has long been fighting against public-sector unions.工党长期与公共部门工会对立。 [D] Public-sector unions seldom get in trouble for their actions. 💡 考场思路第二段：they can shut things down without suffering much in the way of consequences——他们可以停工而不必承担太多后果。= 很少因行动惹麻烦。

entries.title: It can be learned from Paragraph 4 that the income in the state sector is ___.
entries.text: It can be learned from Paragraph 4 that the income in the state sector is ___. [A] illegally secured. 非法获得的。 [B] indirectly augmented. [C] excessively increased. 过度增加的。 [D] fairly adjusted. 得到公平调整。 答案 B It can be learned from Paragraph 4 that the income in the state sector is ___.从第4段中可以了解到，国有部门的收入为___。 [A] illegally secured.非法获得的。 [B] indirectly augmented. [C] excessively increased.过度增加的。 [D] fairly adjusted.得到公平调整。 💡 考场思路第四段：工资增长适度，但通过增加假期和养老金变相增加——即收入是间接增加的。indirectly augmented。

entries.title: The example of the unions in Wisconsin shows that unions ___.
entries.text: The example of the unions in Wisconsin shows that unions ___. [A] often run against the current political system. 常常与现行政治体制相悖。 [B] can change people's political attitudes. 能改变人们的政治态度。 [C] may be a barrier to public-sector reforms. [D] are dominant in the government. 在政府中占主导地位。 答案 C The example of the unions in Wisconsin shows that unions ___.威斯康星州工会的例子表明，工会___。 [A] often run against the current political system.常常与现行政治体制相悖。 [B] can change people's political attitudes.能改变人们的政治态度。 [C] may be a barrier to public-sector reforms. [D] are dominant in the government.在政府中占主导地位。 💡 考场思路威斯康星州工会召集数千人对抗州长推动改革——说明工会阻碍公共部门改革。

entries.title: John Donahue's attitude towards the public-sector system is one of ___.
entries.text: John Donahue's attitude towards the public-sector system is one of ___. [A] disapproval. [B] tolerance. 宽容；容忍。 [C] appreciation. 欣赏；感激。 [D] indifference. 冷漠。 答案 A John Donahue's attitude towards the public-sector system is one of ___.John Donahue对公共部门系统的态度是___之一。 [A] disapproval. [B] tolerance.宽容；容忍。 [C] appreciation.欣赏；感激。 [D] indifference.冷漠。 💡 考场思路末句：a public-sector system that does not reward high achievers may be a much bigger problem——不奖励高成就者的制度是个大问题。Disapproval。 核心词汇 unionize v. 加入工会 thrive v. 兴盛 patrol v. 巡查/监督 backload v. 变相拖延 pension n. 养老金 draw-out adj. 旷日持久的 clamp down 强硬压制 stay put 安于现状

entries.title: In physics, one approach takes this impulse for unification to its extreme, and
entries.text: In physics, one approach takes this impulse for unification to its extreme, and seeks a theory of everything—a single generative equation for all we see. In physics, one approach takes this impulse for unification to its extreme, and seeks a theory of everything—a single generative equation for all we see. 在物理学中，有一种方法将这种对统一性的渴求推向极致，寻求一种万有理论——一个能阐释我们所见一切的生成性公式。 采分点① impulse 冲动/渴求；② unification 统一；③ take...to its extreme 推向极致；④ a theory of everything 万有理论。

entries.title: Here, Darwinism seems to offer justification, for if all humans share common ori
entries.text: Here, Darwinism seems to offer justification, for if all humans share common origins, it seems reasonable to suppose that cultural diversity could also be traced to more constrained beginnings. Here, Darwinism seems to offer justification, for if all humans share common origins, it seems reasonable to suppose that cultural diversity could also be traced to more constrained beginnings. 这里，达尔文学说似乎提供了正当理由：如果全人类有共同的起源，那么似乎有理由认为，文化多样性也可以追溯到更为狭窄的开端。 采分点① justification 正当理由；② trace to 追溯到；③ constrained beginnings 受局限的开端。

entries.title: To filter out what is unique from what is shared might enable us to understand h
entries.text: To filter out what is unique from what is shared might enable us to understand how complex cultural behavior arose and what guides it in evolutionary or cognitive terms. To filter out what is unique from what is shared might enable us to understand how complex cultural behavior arose and what guides it in evolutionary or cognitive terms. 把独特之物从共享之物中筛选出来，或许能让我们理解复杂的文化行为是如何产生的，以及从进化或认知角度看是什么在引导它。 采分点① filter out 筛选；② arise 产生；③ in...terms 从……角度；④ cognitive 认知的。

entries.title: The second, by Joshua Greenberg, takes a more empirical approach to universality
entries.text: The second, by Joshua Greenberg, takes a more empirical approach to universality, identifying traits (particularly in word order) shared by many languages, which are considered to represent biases that result from cognitive constraints. The second, by Joshua Greenberg, takes a more empirical approach to universality, identifying traits (particularly in word order) shared by many languages, which are considered to represent biases that result from cognitive constraints. 第二个由约书亚·格林伯格提出，它对普遍性采取了更为实证的研究方法，识别出许多语言共有的特征（尤其是词序方面），这些特征被认为代表了由认知局限所导致的偏向。 采分点① empirical 实证的；② universality 普遍性；③ trait 特征；④ cognitive constraints 认知局限。

entries.title: Chomsky's grammar should show patterns of language change that are independent o
entries.text: Chomsky's grammar should show patterns of language change that are independent of the family tree or the pathway tracked through it, whereas Greenbergian universality predicts strong co-dependencies between particular types of word-order relations. Chomsky's grammar should show patterns of language change that are independent of the family tree or the pathway tracked through it, whereas Greenbergian universality predicts strong co-dependencies between particular types of word-order relations. 乔姆斯基的语法应该显示出独立于语言谱系或沿其追溯路径的语言变化模式，而格林伯格式的普遍性则预测特定类型的词序关系之间存在强烈的相互依存。 采分点① be independent of 独立于；② family tree 语言谱系；③ whereas 而（对比）；④ co-dependency 相互依存。

entries.title: Suppose you are the chairman of the Student Union. Write an email to a group of
entries.text: Suppose you are the chairman of the Student Union. Write an email to a group of international students who are about to study at your university. In the email, welcome them and give them some advice on campus life. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the email. Use "Li Ming" instead. Do not write the address. Part A 小作文（10分）— 欢迎邮件 原题指令 Directions Suppose you are the chairman of the Student Union. Write an email to a group of international students who are about to study at your university. In the email, welcome them and give them some advice on campus life. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the email. Use "Li Ming" instead. Do not write the address. 【译文】假设你是学生会主席。给即将来你校就读的一群留学生写一封电子邮件，欢迎他们并就校园生活提一些建议。字数约100词。邮件末尾不要署自己的名字，使用“李明”代替。不要写地址。 题目 一些国际学生即将来到你的大学。以学生会名义给他们写一封电子邮件：1）表示欢迎，2）就校园生活给他们提一些建议。约100词，落款Li Ming，不写地址。 审题 ① 格式：邮件；② 语气：热情友好；③ 内容：欢迎+2-3条具体建议（选课、交通、社交/生活适应）。 参考范文 Dear Friends, On behalf of the Students' Union, I would like to extend our warmest welcome to you. We are genuinely thrilled to have you join our campus community. To help you settle in smoothly, I would like to offer a few practical tips. First, make good use of the course-selection system and consult your academic advisor before finalizing your timetable. Second, the campus subway station is the most convenient way to explore the city, so do get a transportation card. entries.text: Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should 1) describe the drawing briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Picture: The drawing shows two people facing a bottle that has fallen over and spilled some liquid. One frowns and cries, "It's all over!" while the other says optimistically, "Luckily there is still some left." Faced with the same situation, the two hold completely different attitudes. Part B 大作文（20分）— 乐观与悲观（面对同一只打翻的瓶子） 原题指令 Directions Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should 1) describe the drawing briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Picture: The drawing shows two people facing a bottle that has fallen over and spilled some liquid. One frowns and cries, "It's all over!" while the other says optimistically, "Luckily there is still some left." Faced with the same situation, the two hold completely different attitudes. 【译文】根据下面的图画写一篇160–200词的短文。文中应： 1）简要描述图画；2）说明其寓意；3）给出你的评论。 请在答题卡2上工整书写。 图画描述 图中有两个人面对一只打翻在地、洒了一些液体的瓶子。一个人愁眉苦脸地喊道："全完了！"另一个人却乐观地说："幸好还剩点儿。"面对同一种境况，两人态度截然不同。 审题框架 三段式：①描述图画（打翻的瓶子+两种反应）；②阐释寓意（不同人面对困境有乐观和悲观两种态度，乐观更可取）；③评论（应保持积极心态）。160-200词。 参考范文 The cartoon vividly depicts two men reacting in opposite ways to the same spilled bottle. One buries his face in despair, crying, "It's all ruined!" while the other, relieved, exclaims, "Fortunately, there is still some left!" The contrast could not be sharper. The drawing conveys a thought-provoking message: our attitude often matters more than the situation itself.
